findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 2 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: Two misprints in the solution of Example 12: (i) the book prints P(10) = 5.000\, e^{0.05 \times 10} with a decimal point; it should be 5{,}000\, e^{0.05 \times 10} (five thousand), as the next expression shows. (ii) the book prints t = \ln 2 / r = 0.69310.05 = 13.86 with the division sign missing; it should be t = \ln 2 / r = 0.6931 / 0.05 = 13.86.
